evidence.title: GitHub - osolmaz/pi-workflows: Workflow engine, JSON control-flow tool, and live terminal viewer for the pi coding agent

name: pi-workflows
summary: Workflow engine for the Pi coding agent: TypeScript graph workflows, JSON control flow and a live terminal viewer.
description: Define multi-step agent workflows as TypeScript graphs and trigger them from a Pi conversation with /workflow; agent steps run in the current conversation and return structured output while compute, notify, action and checkpoint nodes cover the rest. A Rust TUI (piw) and an in-editor widget show each run live over durable SQLite state.
contains: TypeScript graph workflows with agent, compute, notify, action/shell and checkpoint nodes
/workflow start, pause, resume, cancel and answer commands
Rust piw terminal viewer plus an in-Pi node widget
durable run state in a local SQLite database
six bundled skills: pi-workflows, monitor, autoplan, autodoc, autoimplement, sanity-check
resource managers and a Herdr plugin
npm package @osolmaz/pi-workflows; Rust viewer crate pi-workflows on crates.io
